review_method: Assistant visual inspection of actual source frames rendered without model overlays. Singles 2000-2099 and doubles 600-649 inspected frame by frame; singles contact neighborhoods additionally inspected at 1280x720. Existing model suggestions and source sample windows were known, so this is development review rather than blinded independent evaluation. No human second annotator has reviewed these labels.
limitations: Two very small partial-rally development windows; not a held-out benchmark.
All shot families, stroke sides, and player handedness remain unknown. No serve or rally-ending labels were fabricated.
Contact times are nearest observable source frames with +/-1-2 frame uncertainty; raster blur and compression limit precision.

Shuttle point sample deliberately selects clearly visible positives and cannot estimate whole-video visibility recall or false detections. Coordinates describe center of visible streak, with approximately 3 px uncertainty.

Live/replay scene requires contextual judgment. Singles likely live is an explicit inference from score progression; conservative stored scene remains unknown. Doubles scene has not been contextually established.
